title: Factory's State column shows each state's whole label instead of cutting it off
description: On the Factory tab, in a goal's (or Ungrouped's) Sessions table, the State column cuts its badge off: the builder's screenshot shows "FAI..." for Failed and "WA..." for a waiting state. The badge is StateBadge (apps/desktop/src/views/factory/state-badge.tsx, a Mantine Badge with labels from workstream-state.ts), rendered in apps/desktop/src/views/factory/goal-sessions.tsx. A state that can't be read defeats the column. Guess: the column is too narrow for the badge's uppercase label at the window width the builder uses (about 900 px of content).
acceptanceCriteria: Every state label in STATE_LABELS shows in full in the Factory Sessions table at a content width of 900 px
The task title and step columns stay readable at that width; no column's text overlaps another's
A failed session's state reads as a word a person understands (for example Failed), not a truncated fragment
